I spend three days of real time getting the print settings right. The elbows are the trouble spot, and the printer only starts on them around five hours into the print. Then another working day goes on fighting nozzle clogs caused by poor-quality filament.

Only after all that do I finally get the result you see in the photos.

So, you know what? It looks like the rumours are exaggerated. AI won't take our jobs. We'll simply use it to tackle more ambitious projects.
